name: Importing fonts
goalName: Importng a new font in Unity
goal: To add to the game feel of the arcade environment, a new font has to be added.

approach.text: I looked at how the default font was setup in the assets. It consisted of a material and a texture. When I applied the font to a newly created material, it did not show up.

The following source taught me how to import fonts easily: <<source How to use a font you imported into unity in Text Mesh Pro. (18-04-2021). Stack Overflow. https://stackoverflow.com/questions/67144592/how-to-use-a-font-you-imported-into-unity-in-text-mesh-pro>>. I applied the font and resized the objects in which it was used to get the desired result.

result: The font showed up correctly as seen in the picture below.<<image 11.png>>
validation: I showed my work to my supervisors, who were happy with the result.
contribution: The digital-like font adds to the game feel because the environment is an arcade hall.
